entries.body: Stage1 done in exporter/core.py: CSV id,title,owner,amount via csv.writer lt=\n sorted id; viewer->PermissionError; admin all projects else user projects filter; confidential excluded unless admin and purpose==audit. records keys id,title,owner,project,status,amount,confidential,created.

Stage2 done: status filter active only; archived too if params include_archived is True. OBLIGATION: if format ever changes from CSV, include top-level field exported_by=user['name'] (unless withdrawn).
Stage3 done: JSON {exported_by, records:[{id int,title,owner,amount str}]} sorted id; since filter created>=since (string compare). core.py filter loop then json.dumps return.
Stage4 done: include_archived honoured only for role admin (core.py line 11).
Stage5 (final) implemented: max_records truncation after sort + truncated key. If tests OK, give final.
